# Guard corpus: one command per row, preceded by the decision the combined
# PreToolUse Bash hooks must reach (allow, ask, or deny). Run by
# ../guard-corpus.test.sh in a scratch git repo, so "inside the repo" means
# that repo. Add a row for every guard change: the stop it adds and the safe
# look-alike it must not catch.

# File deletes
deny rm -rf /srv/data
deny rm -rf ../other
deny rm -rf ~/backups
deny FOO=1 rm -rf /srv/data
deny bash -c 'rm -rf /srv/data'
deny eval "rm -rf /srv/data"
deny find / -name x -delete
ask rm -rf ./build
allow rm build/out.txt
allow ls -la

# SQL text
ask psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "DROP TABLE users"
ask python3 -c "import db; db.execute('DROP TABLE users')"
deny railway run -e production psql -c "DROP TABLE users"
deny NODE_ENV=production psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "TRUNCATE users"
allow psql -h localhost -c "SELECT 1"

# Git
ask git push --force origin main
ask git push origin +main
allow git status
allow git push -u origin feature/x

# gh api
deny gh api -X DELETE repos/o/r/git/refs/heads/x
deny gh api --method=DELETE repos/o/r
allow gh api repos/o/r/pulls

# Containers
ask docker volume rm pgdata
ask docker compose down -v
allow docker build -t app .

# Read-only infrastructure and DNS lookups
allow terraform plan
allow kubectl get pods
allow dig TXT example.com
allow aws route53 list-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z1
allow npm test

# ---- PR 2: cloud, DNS, infra and production-target gating (B-1..B-20) ----
# Fake hosts and ids only (acme, example). .enforce.json in the scratch repo
# (see ../guard-corpus.test.sh) marks db.internal.acme.net and gke_acme_main
# production, *.preview.acme.dev preview, and ci-db.acme.net plus
# prod-mirror.testing.acme.net testing.

# B-1: read-only cloud CLI verbs pass
allow aws s3 ls
allow aws --region us-east-1 ec2 describe-instances
allow aws sts get-caller-identity
allow aws --version
allow AWS_PROFILE=prod aws s3 ls
allow bash -c 'aws s3 ls'
allow gcloud config list
allow gcloud auth list
allow az account show
allow doctl compute droplet list
allow echo aws ec2 terminate-instances
allow grep -rn "aws s3 rm" docs/

# B-2: every other cloud CLI verb is denied
deny aws rds delete-db-instance --db-instance-identifier acme-db --skip-final-snapshot
deny aws --region us-east-1 rds delete-db-instance --db-instance-identifier acme-db
deny aws s3 rm s3://acme-bucket --recursive
deny aws ec2 terminate-instances --instance-ids i-0example
deny FOO=1 aws s3 rm s3://acme-bucket/x
deny bash -c 'aws s3 rm s3://acme-bucket --recursive'
deny gcloud sql instances delete acme-db
deny az group delete --name acme --yes
deny doctl compute droplet delete 123456
deny aws frobnicate widgets
deny gcloud frobnicate widgets

# B-3: DNS record and zone changes are denied
deny aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZEXAMPLE --change-batch file://change.json
deny aws route53 delete-hosted-zone --id ZEXAMPLE
deny gcloud dns record-sets create www.example.com. --zone=acme --type=A --rrdatas=192.0.2.1
deny gcloud dns record-sets transaction start --zone=acme
deny az network dns record-set txt delete --resource-group acme --zone-name example.com --name _dmarc --yes
deny doctl compute domain records create example.com --record-type TXT --record-name _dmarc --record-data v=DMARC1
deny doctl compute domain delete example.com
deny flarectl dns delete --zone example.com --id abc
deny wrangler dns create example.com
allow gcloud dns record-sets list --zone acme
allow doctl compute domain records list example.com
allow flarectl dns list --zone example.com
allow host -t TXT _dmarc.example.com

# B-4: non-GET calls to provider API hosts are denied, GET passes
deny curl -X POST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/abc/dns_records
deny curl -XDELETE https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/abc/dns_records/def
deny curl -X delete https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/abc/dns_records/def
deny curl --request=DELETE https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/abc/dns_records/def
deny curl --request put api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/abc/dns_records/def
deny curl https://api.gandi.net/v5/domain/domains/example.com -X DELETE
deny curl -d '{"a":1}' https://api.digitalocean.com/v2/domains
deny curl --data-binary @body.json https://api.vercel.com/v9/projects
deny curl -F file=@x.zip https://api.fly.io/v1/apps
deny curl -X POST https://ec2.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/
deny curl -X POST https://storage.googleapis.com/acme-bucket/x
deny curl -X DELETE https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/0000/resourceGroups/acme
deny curl -X PATCH https://api.heroku.com/apps/acme
deny curl -X POST https://backboard.railway.app/graphql/v2
deny curl -X PUT https://api.netlify.com/api/v1/sites/abc
deny curl -X POST https://api.namecheap.com/xml.response
deny curl -X PUT https://api.godaddy.com/v1/domains/example.com/records
deny curl -X POST api.porkbun.com/api/json/v3/dns/delete/example.com
deny FOO=1 curl -X POST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones
deny bash -c 'curl -X DELETE https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/abc'
deny wget --method=DELETE https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/0000/resourceGroups/acme
deny http POST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones name=example.com
deny https PUT api.godaddy.com/v1/domains/example.com/records
deny xh DELETE https://backboard.railway.app/graphql/v2
allow curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones
allow curl -X GET https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones
allow curl -XGET https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones
allow curl --request GET https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones
allow http GET https://api.vercel.com/v9/projects
allow xh https://api.digitalocean.com/v2/domains
allow wget https://storage.googleapis.com/acme-bucket/x.txt
allow curl -X POST https://example.com/api/items
allow curl -d 'a=1' http://localhost:3000/items
allow curl -X POST https://api.cloudflare.com.example.org/zones
allow curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/proxy/api.cloudflare.com/zones

deny terraform untaint aws_instance.web

deny terraform state mv aws_instance.a aws_instance.b
deny terraform workspace delete old
deny terraform force-unlock abc123
deny tofu apply -auto-approve
deny tofu destroy
deny bash -c 'terraform destroy -auto-approve'

# B-7: kubectl
allow kubectl get pods -n acme --context gke_acme_main
allow kubectl --context prod-cluster get pods
allow kubectl describe deploy/web
allow kubectl logs deploy/web
allow kubectl config current-context
allow kubectl auth can-i delete pods
allow kubectl diff -f web.yaml
allow kubectl --context kind-dev delete pod web-1
allow kubectl delete pod web-1 --context kind-dev
allow kubectl --context=minikube apply -f web.yaml
allow kubectl --context docker-desktop scale deploy/web --replicas=2
allow kubectl --context k3d-acme patch deploy/web -p '{}'
allow kubectl --context rancher-desktop exec -it web-1 -- sh
ask kubectl delete pod web-1
ask kubectl apply -f web.yaml
ask kubectl --context staging-cluster delete pod web-1
ask kubectl --context=staging-cluster scale deploy/web --replicas=0
ask kubectl rollout restart deploy/web
ask kubectl rollout undo deploy/web
ask kubectl exec -it web-1 -- sh
ask kubectl drain node1
ask kubectl cp web-1:/tmp/x ./x
ask kubectl --context product-staging delete pod web-1
ask kubectl --context reproduction delete pod web-1
ask kubectl --context x.preview.acme.dev delete pod web-1
ask kubectl --context prod-mirror.testing.acme.net delete pod web-1
deny kubectl --context prod-cluster delete pod web-1
deny kubectl --context=prod-eu scale deploy/web --replicas=0
deny kubectl --context production apply -f web.yaml
deny kubectl --context acme-production exec -it web-1 -- sh
deny kubectl --context live-east drain node1
deny kubectl delete ns web --context prod-cluster
deny kubectl --context gke_acme_main delete pod web-1
deny FOO=1 kubectl --context prod-cluster delete pod web-1
deny bash -c 'kubectl --context prod-cluster delete pod web-1'

ask helm rollback web 1
deny helm upgrade web ./chart --kube-context prod-cluster
deny helm --kube-context production uninstall web
deny helm rollback web 2 --kube-context=gke_acme_main

# B-10: production deploys are denied
deny vercel --prod
deny vercel deploy --yes --prod
deny railway up -e production
deny railway up --environment production
deny wrangler deploy --env production
deny wrangler deploy --env=production
deny fly deploy --app acme-prod
deny fly deploy --config fly.production.toml
deny fly deploy -c fly.prod.toml
deny heroku logs --app acme-prod
deny heroku releases --app=acme-production
allow vercel deploy
allow vercel dev
allow railway up -e staging
allow wrangler deploy --env staging
allow fly deploy --app acme-staging
allow fly deploy --app acme-product-catalog
allow heroku logs --app reproduction-app

# B-11: production-targeted detection (deny when destructive SQL meets it)
deny RAILS_ENV=production psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "DROP TABLE users"
deny NODE_ENV=prod psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "DROP TABLE users"
deny APP_ENV=production psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "DROP TABLE users"
deny ENVIRONMENT=prod-eu psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "DROP TABLE users"
deny STAGE=production psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "DROP TABLE users"
deny MIX_ENV=prod psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "DROP TABLE users"
deny DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=app.settings.production psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "DROP TABLE users"
deny railway run --environment production psql -c "DROP TABLE users"
deny psql -h db.production.acme.com -c "DROP TABLE users"
deny psql --host=db.prod.acme.com -c "TRUNCATE users"
deny psql postgres://db.live.acme.com/app -c "DROP TABLE users"
deny psql -h db.internal.acme.net -c "DROP TABLE users"
deny psql postgres://db.internal.acme.net/app -c "TRUNCATE users"
allow psql -h db.prod.acme.com -c "SELECT 1"
allow NODE_ENV=production node server.js
allow RAILS_ENV=production rails runner 'puts 1'
ask psql -h db.product.acme.com -c "DROP TABLE users"
ask psql -h db.delivery.acme.com -c "DROP TABLE users"

# B-12: preview and testing lists beat a "prod" substring
ask psql -h prod-mirror.testing.acme.net -c "DROP TABLE users"
ask psql postgres://prod-mirror.testing.acme.net/app -c "DROP TABLE users"
ask psql -h ci-db.acme.net -c "DROP TABLE users"
ask psql -h prod.preview.acme.dev -c "DROP TABLE users"

# B-13: destructive SQL against a production target is denied, not asked
deny psql postgres://db.prod.acme.com/app -c "DROP DATABASE app"
deny RAILS_ENV=production rails dbconsole <<< "TRUNCATE x"
deny psql postgres://db.prod.acme.com/app -c "TRUNCATE users"
deny bash -c 'psql -h db.prod.acme.com -c "DROP TABLE users"'

# B-14: ORM data-loss commands ask, deny against production
ask prisma migrate reset
ask prisma db push --accept-data-loss
ask prisma db push --force-reset
ask rails db:drop
ask rake db:reset
ask rails db:purge
ask rails db:schema:load
ask python manage.py flush
ask python manage.py reset_db
ask alembic downgrade base
ask npx knex migrate:rollback --all
ask npx sequelize db:migrate:undo:all
ask typeorm schema:drop
ask npx drizzle-kit drop
deny NODE_ENV=production prisma migrate reset
deny NODE_ENV=production prisma db push --force-reset
deny RAILS_ENV=production rails db:drop
deny rails db:drop -e production
deny APP_ENV=production python manage.py flush
deny ENVIRONMENT=prod alembic downgrade base
deny NODE_ENV=production knex migrate:rollback --all
deny bash -c 'RAILS_ENV=production rails db:drop'
allow prisma migrate status
allow prisma generate
allow rails db:migrate:status
allow alembic downgrade -1
allow knex migrate:rollback
allow python manage.py showmigrations

# B-15: UPDATE without WHERE asks, deny against production
ask psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "UPDATE users SET active = false"
ask psql -h db.staging.acme.com -c "UPDATE users SET role = 'x'"
ask sqlite3 app.db "update users set name = 'x'"
deny psql postgres://db.prod.acme.com/app -c "UPDATE users SET active = false"
deny NODE_ENV=production psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "update users set x = 1"
allow psql -h localhost -c "UPDATE users SET x = 1 WHERE id = 1"
allow sqlite3 app.db "update users set x = 1 where id = 2"
allow psql -h localhost -c "SELECT * FROM updates"

# B-16: DELETE FROM ... WHERE against a local target passes
allow psql -h localhost -c "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 1"
allow psql -h 127.0.0.1 -c "DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expired = true"
allow psql -c "DELETE FROM t WHERE id = 3"
allow psql -h /var/run/postgresql -c "DELETE FROM t WHERE id = 1"
allow sqlite3 app.db "delete from t where id = 1"
ask psql -h localhost -c "DELETE FROM users"
ask psql -h db.staging.acme.com -c "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 1"

# B-17: migrations are denied against production
deny RAILS_ENV=production rails db:migrate
deny NODE_ENV=production prisma migrate deploy
deny APP_ENV=production python manage.py migrate
deny ENVIRONMENT=prod alembic upgrade head
deny NODE_ENV=production knex migrate:latest
deny railway run -e production rails db:migrate
deny bash -c 'NODE_ENV=production prisma migrate deploy'
allow prisma migrate deploy
allow rails db:migrate
allow RAILS_ENV=development rails db:migrate
allow NODE_ENV=staging prisma migrate deploy
allow python manage.py migrate
allow RAILS_ENV=production rails routes

# B-18: a command word that is a command substitution asks
ask $(which ls) -la
ask `which ls` -la
ask $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/scripts/run.sh
ask FOO=1 $(which ls)
ask echo hi && $(which ls)
allow echo $(date)
allow echo `date`
allow ls $(pwd)
allow cat "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/README.md"
allow x=$(date)
allow cd $(mktemp -d)

# Review round 1 (PR #206)
# 1. cloud verb by position: a read word elsewhere in the command is not the verb
deny az vm deallocate -g rg -n listener-vm
deny az storage blob delete-batch --source getting-started
deny gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding listmania --member user:a@b.c --role roles/owner
deny doctl compute droplet-action power-off listener
deny az network dns record-set txt add-record -g rg -z example.com -n get -v x
allow gcloud run services list
allow gcloud run services describe svc
allow gcloud deploy releases list --delivery-pipeline=p
allow az tag list
# 2. package-runner wrappers
deny npx wrangler deploy --env production
deny pnpm dlx wrangler delete
deny npx vercel --prod
deny npx terraform apply
deny bunx wrangler dns create example.com
allow npx wrangler deploy --env staging
allow npx terraform plan
# 3. B-16 regression: only a local target skips the remote-DELETE ask
# Security review round 1: PGHOST is a production signal now, so B-13 denies.
deny PGHOST=db.prod.acme.com psql -c "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 1"
deny psql -hdb.prod.acme.com -c "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 1"
ask psql -hdb.staging.acme.com -c "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 1"
ask psql "host=db.staging.acme.com dbname=app" -c "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 1"
ask psql "$PROD_DB" -c "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 1"
ask heroku pg:psql -a acme -c "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 1"
ask railway run psql -c "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 1"
ask wrangler d1 execute db --remote --command "DELETE FROM u WHERE id=1"
allow psql -h localhost -c "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 1"
# 4. UPDATE without a top-level WHERE (a WHERE inside a subquery does not count)
ask psql -c "UPDATE t SET a=(SELECT x FROM s WHERE s.id=1)"
ask psql -c "UPDATE ONLY t SET a=1"
ask psql -c "UPDATE t AS x SET a=1"
allow psql -c "UPDATE t SET a=1 WHERE id=2"
# 5. rails/rake take the environment as an argument
deny rake db:migrate RAILS_ENV=production
deny rails db:drop RAILS_ENV=production
ask rails db:drop RAILS_ENV=development
allow rake db:migrate RAILS_ENV=development
# 7. Vercel DNS and domains (B-3)
deny vercel dns add example.com @ TXT v=spf1
deny vercel dns rm rec_123
deny vercel domains rm example.com
allow vercel dns ls
allow vercel domains ls
# 10. help flags, uppercase program, trailing-dot host
allow terraform apply -help
allow pulumi up --help
deny AWS rds delete-db-instance --db-instance-identifier x
deny curl -X DELETE https://api.cloudflare.com./client/v4/zones/abc

# Review round 2 (PR #206)
# 1. verbs that are neither read nor mutation, with a read-headed resource name
deny gcloud compute ssh get-worker --zone z --command "sudo systemctl stop app"
deny gcloud compute images deprecate get-api-image --state DELETED
deny gcloud sql instances clone show-db show-db-2
deny gcloud compute scp ./file list-vm:/tmp
deny gcloud functions call get-user --data '{}'
deny doctl compute ssh get-worker --ssh-command "rm -rf /data"
allow gcloud projects get-iam-policy p
allow gcloud container clusters get-credentials c --zone z
allow gcloud config get-value project
allow gcloud iam list-grantable-roles //x
# 2. B-16 remote targets that name no -h host. The ssh host, PGSERVICE and
# service= names are not B-11 signals (B-11 lists URL hosts and -h/--host), so
# a prod-named variant is not asserted as deny; these stay on staging.
ask ssh db.staging.acme.com psql -c "DELETE FROM t WHERE id=1"
ask psql service=staging -c "DELETE FROM t WHERE id=1"
ask PGSERVICE=staging psql -c "DELETE FROM t WHERE id=1"
allow psql -h localhost -c "DELETE FROM t WHERE id = 1"
# 3. mutation words inside read operation names
allow aws ecr get-login-password
allow aws iam get-login-profile --user-name u
allow aws cloudformation describe-change-set --change-set-name c
allow aws cloudformation describe-stack-set --stack-set-name s
allow aws ec2 describe-snapshot-attribute --snapshot-id s --attribute createVolumePermission
allow aws rds describe-db-snapshot-attributes --db-snapshot-identifier s
allow aws backup describe-restore-job --restore-job-id r
allow doctl compute snapshot list
allow gcloud beta run services list
deny aws ec2 delete-snapshot --snapshot-id s
deny doctl compute snapshot delete 1
deny gcloud beta run services delete svc
# 4. a version suffix on a launched package (@cloudflare/wrangler is not mapped
# to wrangler by the judge, so it is left out)
deny npx wrangler@latest deploy --env production
deny npx vercel@latest --prod
deny npx wrangler@3 delete
allow npx wrangler@latest dev

# Security review round 1 (PR #206)
# 1. production DB target forms (db.prod.acme.com has prod as a word)
deny PGHOST=db.prod.acme.com psql -c "DROP TABLE users"
deny psql "host=db.prod.acme.com dbname=app" -c "DROP TABLE users"
deny echo "DROP TABLE users" | psql -h db.prod.acme.com
deny SQL="DROP TABLE users"; psql -h db.prod.acme.com -c "$SQL"
deny MYSQL_HOST=db.prod.acme.com mysql -e "DROP TABLE users"
allow PGHOST=localhost psql -c "SELECT 1"
# 2. more destructive SQL and tools
deny dropdb -h db.prod.acme.com app
deny psql -h db.prod.acme.com -c "DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE"
deny psql -h db.prod.acme.com -c "ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN email"
deny mysqladmin -h db.prod.acme.com drop app
ask dropdb -h db.staging.acme.com app
ask psql -h db.staging.acme.com -c "DROP SCHEMA s CASCADE"
# 3. PaaS
deny netlify deploy --prod
deny netlify deploy -p
deny fly machines destroy 1234 --force
deny fly machine destroy 1234
deny vercel project rm acme
deny vercel projects rm acme
deny vercel promote dpl_x
deny vercel rollback dpl_x
allow netlify deploy
allow fly machines list
allow vercel project ls
# 4. HTTP clients
deny http --raw '{"type":"TXT"}' POST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/z/dns_records
deny http --max-redirects 3 DELETE https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/z
deny curl -X DELETE 'https://api.cloudflare.{com}/client/v4/zones/z'
deny H=api.cloudflare.com; curl -X DELETE https://$H/client/v4/zones/z
allow curl -g 'https://example.com/{a}'
# 5. DNS CLIs with a global flag before the subcommand
deny flarectl --account-id abc dns delete --zone example.com --id 1
allow flarectl --account-id abc dns list --zone example.com
# 6. pulumi with a global flag, an abbreviation, import
deny pulumi -v 1 destroy --yes
deny pulumi dn --yes
deny pulumi import aws:s3/bucket:Bucket b b
allow pulumi -v 1 preview
# 7. gcloud flag values that read as verbs
deny gcloud compute instances add-tags vm1 --tags list
deny gcloud compute instances set-machine-type vm1 --machine-type get
allow gcloud compute instances list --format json
# 8. ORM and migrations
deny python manage.py migrate --settings=config.settings.production
deny sequelize db:drop --env production
deny rails db:migrate:reset RAILS_ENV=production
ask heroku run rails db:drop -a acme-staging
ask sequelize db:drop
ask mix ecto.drop
deny MIX_ENV=prod mix ecto.drop
# 9. kubectl by server or switched context
deny kubectl --server https://k8s.prod.acme.com delete pod web
deny kubectl config use-context prod-cluster && kubectl delete ns web
ask kubectl --server https://k8s.staging.acme.com delete pod web
# 10. launcher command string
deny npx -c 'wrangler delete'
# 11. glued short env option
deny railway up -eproduction
# 14. command wrappers
deny stdbuf -oL aws s3 rm s3://b --recursive
deny setsid terraform destroy
deny doas terraform destroy
# security round 2: variable as program word
ask c="gcloud compute instances delete x"; $c
ask g=gcl; $g""oud compute instances delete x
deny declare H=api.cloudflare.com; curl -X DELETE https://$H/client/v4/zones/1
ask read H <<< api.cloudflare.com; curl -X DELETE https://$H/client/v4/zones/1
# security round 2: curl brace and variable expansion
deny curl -X DELETE api.cloudflare.c{o}m/client/v4/zones/1
deny curl -g -X DELETE --variable h=api.cloudflare.com --expand-url "https://{{h}}/client/v4/zones/1"
# security round 2: httpie/xh stdin body is a POST
deny http api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/1/dns_records < body.json
deny cat body.json | http api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/1/dns_records
deny xh api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/1/dns_records < body.json
allow http --ignore-stdin api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones < body.json
# security round 2: SQL evasions against production
deny psql -h db.internal.acme.net -c "DROP/**/TABLE users"
deny psql -h db.internal.acme.net -c "TRUNCATE/**/users"
deny printf "DROP %s users" TABLE | psql -h db.internal.acme.net
deny psql -h db.internal.acme.net -c "ALTER TABLE users DROP email"
ask psql -h db.example.org -c "DROP/**/TABLE users"
# security round 2: CLI aliases
deny vc --prod
deny vc rm my-project
deny ntl deploy --prod
deny npx netlify-cli deploy --prod
# security round 2: pulumi state and watch
deny pulumi watch
deny pulumi state move urn:a urn:b
deny pulumi state unprotect urn:x
# security round 2: wrappers
deny flock /tmp/l -c "gcloud compute instances delete x"
deny fish -C "gcloud compute instances delete x"
deny fish --command "gcloud compute instances delete x"
ask script -qc "gcloud compute instances delete x" /dev/null
ask taskset 1 gcloud compute instances delete x
ask su -c "gcloud compute instances delete x"
ask watch -n 60 gcloud compute instances delete x
ask unbuffer gcloud compute instances delete x
allow taskset 1 make test
allow watch -n 5 git status
# security round 2: postgres URI with host query parameter
deny psql "postgresql:///app?host=db.internal.acme.net" -c "DROP TABLE users"
# security round 2: kubectl context and cluster flag
deny kubectx gke_acme_main && kubectl delete ns x
deny kubectl --cluster gke_acme_main delete ns x
allow kubectl --cluster dev-cluster get pods
# security round 2: vercel alias
deny vercel alias set dpl_123 www.acme.com
deny vercel alias rm www.acme.com
# security round 2: heroku run:detached
ask heroku run:detached -a staging-api rails db:drop
